 Advertisement Toyota issues recall for more than 220,000 vehicles: See model affected
 Advertisement Updated: 3:30 PM CDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Laura Rysz Toyota issues recall for more than 220,000 vehicles: See model affected
 Updated: 3:30 PM CDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Laura Rysz Toyota has issued a recall after it said that some vehicles with second-row back seats may fail to remain secure in the event of a crash.
 Related video above: How to stay ahead of recalls 
 Advertisement According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration , the company said 228,367 vehicles are being recalled over the potential issue. 
 The company said on Oct. 20 that "certain 2022-2026 Sienna Hybrid 7-passenger vehicles" are affected.
 According to the safety report issued, some seat backs that are not secured in a locked position may fail to properly restrain occupants, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
 NHTSA said Toyota dealers will update the supplemental restraint system electronic control unit software. For vehicles equipped with the "Mobility as a Service" package, dealers will also replace the two second-row seat backs.
 The company said owner notification letters are expected to be mailed out Dec. 7, and customers can contact Toyota's customer service number at 1-800-331-4331 to see if their vehicle is affected.
